prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original finished environment plate for the final boss room of a premium hand-painted 2D belt-scrolling arcade action game. Panoramic 16:9 landscape composition, complete edge-to-edge background, side-on stage camera looking across a broad fighting floor. No characters, UI, text, logo or watermark.
Setting: the heart of a monumental cast-iron furnace chamber at night. A massive chained tilting POURING CRUCIBLE hangs in the upper center-right, brilliant liquid gold-orange iron pouring in a controlled stream into a gigantic open back-wall furnace channel BEHIND the arena. Towering blackened iron ribs, riveted archways, heavy chains with visible links, fluted copper pipes, hot amber furnace mouths and radiating yellow-white foundry glow in the UPPER HALF. Layered dramatic industrial architecture, colossal scale, luminous smoke volume and painterly heat bloom. This must feel like a climactic final boss arena, distinctly enclosed interior, not an exterior alley.
CRITICAL GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION: bottom 43 percent is entirely OPEN WALKABLE ARENA FLOOR, broad muted cool charcoal and blue-slate metal slabs with subtle engraved seams and very restrained diffuse warm reflections. The rear-floor boundary is about 57 percent from top. Keep the floor flat across the screen, calm and dark enough for character sprites and orange-red attack warning lines to read. No molten pools, pits, stairs, foreground chains, large props or obstacles anywhere on fighting floor. Place all dangerous pouring metal and complex machinery behind the rear floor boundary. Clear central fighting silhouette region. Warm atmosphere is above and behind combatants, with cool subdued floor for contrast.
Art direction: sophisticated crisp hand-painted animation background, deliberate cast iron material variation, dark indigo and charcoal structure against luminous molten copper gold, beautiful thin amber rim light, rich depth from overlapping arches and smoke, controlled high contrast at distant furnace mouth, high craft. Original environment, no franchise imitation, no photorealism, no pixelation, no vignette border.
